[RULES]
G1 Extract every mention of the supplied types from a product review. Return exact spans from the text.

[TYPE] PRODUCT
[DESCRIPTION] The named product or model being reviewed or compared.
P1 Named apps, services and accessories are PRODUCT too ("Apple Music", "AirPods").

[TYPE] BRAND
[DESCRIPTION] A company or brand name.

[TYPE] FEATURE
[DESCRIPTION] A part or property of the product the reviewer comments on, such as the battery, screen or price.
F1 Label the feature word only ("battery"), not the opinion about it.

[TYPE] PROBLEM
[DESCRIPTION] A fault or problem the reviewer reports, as a short phrase ("drains overnight", "keeps crashing").

[TYPE] NOT_AN_ENTITY
NE1 Opinion words, such as "awesome", "slow" or "terrible".

[RULES]
G2 A brand inside a product name belongs to the product: "Samsung Galaxy" is PRODUCT, not BRAND. This overrides everything above.
